finance.about: Approve top-ups and expenses, pay withdrawals and give the accountant what they need.

viewer.name: Look only
viewer.about: Look at registrations and the reports; you cannot change anything.

twoStep.title: Turn on two-step sign-in
twoStep.steps:
Open My account.
Press Turn on two-step sign-in and type your password.
Open an authenticator app on your phone, scan the picture and type the 6-digit code it shows, then press Turn on.
Save the 10 recovery codes somewhere safe: they are shown only once, and each one signs you in once if you lose your phone.

findThings.title: Find things quickly
findThings.steps:
Use the search box at the top of a list: it looks at names, e-mails, buyer numbers, exhibitions and more.
Several words must all match.
Set the filters you use often, then save them as a view to open again with one click.

approve.title: Approve or reject registrations
approve.steps:
Open All registrations.
Choose the exhibition and the status pending (the admin home lists what is waiting under Needs your attention).
Open a registration and check the buyer's details and documents.
Approve it (the buyer is told by e-mail and on the website, and asked to confirm attendance by a date) or reject it.
To decide many at once, tick the rows and use Approve or Reject above the list.

documents.title: Check buyers' documents
documents.steps:
Open Buyer Profiles and choose a buyer.
Look at each document photo or PDF.
Mark it Verified, or reject it with a reason: the buyer is told what to fix and can upload it again.
Use the document filter (for example Missing a document) to find buyers whose documents are incomplete; documents waiting for you show as Pending review.

announce.title: Send an announcement to buyers
announce.steps:
In Buyer Profiles, filter the buyers you want or tick them.
Press Send announcement and write the message (add Russian and Chinese versions if you have them).
Send it: buyers see it under Notifications on the website, and it is e-mailed too when e-mail is on.

doorCheck.title: Check tickets at the door
doorCheck.steps:
Open Check tickets on a phone.
Scan the QR code on the buyer's e-ticket with the camera, or type the ticket code.
If the buyer has confirmed attendance, press Let them in (mark attended). If not, the screen says why they cannot be checked in.

exportList.title: Get a list in Excel
exportList.steps:
Open All registrations.
Choose the exhibition, status or country you need, or search.
Press Export to Excel: the file has what the filters show.

addExhibition.title: Add or update an exhibition
addExhibition.steps:
Open Exhibition Management and add a new exhibition, or open an existing one.
Fill in the name, dates, city, venue, industry, organiser and description, and add a poster picture.
Set when registration opens and closes if you want a window.
Add Russian and Chinese descriptions if you have them; where they are missing, the English text is shown.
Save: the change appears on the website within a minute.

editPages.title: Edit the text of a website page
editPages.steps:
Open Website Pages and choose the page (for example Help Center, Contact or Terms of Service).
Edit the heading, text and list items.
Each language has its own text: check the Russian and Chinese versions too.
Save: the page updates within a minute.

helpAnswers.title: Add an answer to the Help box
helpAnswers.steps:
Open Website Pages and choose Help Center.
Add a question and its answer to the list (and its Russian and Chinese versions).
Save: the help box on every public page searches these answers, and visitors who find nothing can send their question on WhatsApp.

blog.title: Publish an article
blog.steps:
Open Blog Management and add an article: title, text and a cover picture.
Keep it unpublished while you are writing.
Publish it when it is ready: it appears on the website within a minute.

topups.title: Approve a top-up
topups.steps:
Open Rewards Wallet and the Top-ups section.
Open a request and look at the proof the buyer uploaded.
Check it against your Alipay, WeChat or bank record.
Approve (you can change the amount) or reject with a note to the buyer. The points are added when you approve.

withdrawals.title: Pay a withdrawal
withdrawals.steps:
Open Rewards Wallet and the Withdrawals section.
Use the Excel export to get the list to pay, with each buyer's receiving details and QR code.
Pay the buyer outside the site (Alipay, WeChat or bank).
Type your Payment reference and press I have paid — mark as paid. To refuse instead, press Reject and return the points.

expenses.title: Review expense claims
expenses.steps:
Open Rewards Wallet and the Expense claims section.
Open a claim and check the receipt.
Approve (the points are added) or reject with a note to the buyer.

statement.title: Give the accountant the monthly statement
statement.steps:
Open Rewards Wallet and the Overview section.
First look at the books check: it should say the books agree.
Choose the month and press Download the statement.
Send the Excel file to the accountant: it has the opening and closing balance, the movements by kind and a sheet per buyer.

scheduled.title: Have a report e-mailed on a schedule
scheduled.steps:
Open Scheduled reports and press New report.
Choose what to send, how often, and the e-mail addresses that should get it.
The Excel file arrives by e-mail each time (e-mail must be switched on); Send now sends one at once.

look.title: Look up a registration
look.steps:
Open All registrations.
Type a name, e-mail, company or buyer number in the search box, or choose an exhibition or status.
Open a row to see the details. You can look but not change anything.

numbers.title: Read the numbers
numbers.steps:
Open Reports.
Choose the period (for example the last 28 days) and an exhibition, or all of them.
Read the figures: registrations per day or week, by country, by exhibition, and how far registrations get.
